# Incident Response

## Rundll32 Proxy Execution From Suspicious Context

**Technique:** [T1218.011](https://attack.mitre.org/techniques/T1218/011/) · **Rule:** [`T1218.011_rundll32_suspicious_execution`](../T1218.011_rundll32_suspicious_execution/)

| Role | Action |
|---|---|
| SOC L2 | Review image loads (Sysmon 7), network connections and child processes of the rundll32 PID |
| Incident response | Quarantine the DLL, block contacted infrastructure, isolate the host if code executed; for comsvcs MiniDump follow the LSASS playbook |

### Evidence to collect
- Command line and referenced DLL
- Image loads (Sysmon EID 7) for the process
- Network connections from the process

### Containment
1. Quarantine the DLL
2. Isolate the host if code executed
3. Block any contacted infrastructure
